transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. What brings you in to see me?

...Well. My husband thought I should come in. I guess... it's about the house. 

For nearly two years now, I've... I just know the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many receipts my husband tries to show me, or... or how many excuses they all give. I just know what they're doing. 

So... that's why I'm here.
Besides your certainty about the contractor and neighbors, have you ever heard voices or sounds, or seen things that other people don't seem to notice?
No. No, nothing like that. I don't... I don't hear things. I just see what's happening right in front of me.
Aside from this situation with the contractor and neighbors, would you say you've generally had a hard time trusting people throughout your life, even before this all started?
I... no. Not really. I've always gotten along fine with people. It's just... this specific situation. That's all.
